primaryDirection: AI browser applications and browser-agent developer troubleshooting.

selection.method: Current public search plus at least three directly opened task/problem pages per candidate, with observed page dates distinguished from search-snippet labels. Primary product/API docs and nearest ownership compared against all existing guide/keyword records; reviewer-opened evidence is attributed. Search volumes, rankings, traffic and BrowserHub queries remain null.
selection.limitations: Trip, expense and other competitor pages may be vendor claims without independent performance evidence; historical issues are bounded examples. A 404 and inaccessible pages are excluded. All consumer examples are hypothetical; no travel booking, expense submission, job application submission or outreach occurred.

topics.intent: Trip-specific option comparison preserving local date/time, transfer constraints, displayed fare/cancellation observations and source freshness; stop before booking.
topics.addedValue: Constraint table and evidence timestamp per option, with unknown totals and airport/timezone pitfalls. Cancellation text is supplier display, not legal entitlement.

topics.intent: Reconcile each expense draft line to receipt and transaction evidence before human submission.
topics.addedValue: Source-to-line reconciliation with two café draft rows linked to one receipt, item arithmetic, duplicate-candidate state and a separate EUR/USD mismatch; no tax/accounting-policy decision.

topics.intent: Distinguish prepared, draft-saved, submitted and employer-confirmed job applications with evidence by requisition and material version.
topics.addedValue: Employer/requisition and resume version plus append-only raw status label/source/time, separate normalized state and confirmation evidence; no submission/outreach.

topics.intent: Diagnose Playwright drag-and-drop by widget event model and assert the actual resulting order or destination.
topics.addedValue: Separate native HTML DnD, pointer/sensor widgets and canvas; local fixture demonstrates only native HTML5 state change.

topics.intent: Choose direct Playwright route mocks or HAR replay, safely handle unmatched requests and avoid storing secrets.
topics.addedValue: Distinguishes route.fulfill from HAR replay/upstream fallback; fail-closed behavior, matching, service-worker boundary and secret review. Local fixture tests route.fulfill only.

sourceBoundary: Primary docs, directly opened vendor/problem pages, reviewer-opened sources, exact root-run fixture and fictional worked consumer examples are clearly separated. A 404 sample and unavailable pages are excluded from claims.

fixtureExecution.result: One exact-byte local synthetic run passed: native HTML5 order beta,alpha plus loopback context-route synthetic JSON. HAR capture/replay, JS sortable/canvas, real sites/accounts, LLM and browser background traffic were not tested/audited.

metrics.note: Unknown or unavailable is null, not zero; no new measurement or failed-cohort inference.

publication.status: Prepared article and metadata edits only. Root controls review, CI and the formal publication workflow.
